takeaway: Intussusception: an infant with vomiting, rectal bleeding (redcurrant jelly stool) and a sausage-shaped abdominal mass; bowel telescopes into bowel.

question.text: An 8-month-old boy presents with vomiting and rectal bleeding. There is a sausage-shaped mass palpable in the left side of the abdomen. Select the appropriate diagnosis.
question.say: An eight-month-old boy presents with vomiting and rectal bleeding. There is a sausage-shaped mass palpable in the left side of the abdomen. What is the diagnosis?

lines.text: An 8-month-old boy, crying in his cot.
lines.say: Meet this eight-month-old boy, crying in his cot. Young children are the classic patients.
First, he is vomiting into the bowl.

lines.text: A sausage-shaped mass in the abdomen.
lines.say: Then the doctor feels a sausage-shaped mass in his abdomen.

lines.text: Bowel slides into bowel, like a telescope.
lines.say: Here is why. One segment of bowel invaginates into the next, like a telescope folding shut.
(sigh) The trapped bowel bleeds, giving the classic redcurrant jelly stool.
In young children it is most often idiopathic.

lines.text: Remember: vomiting, redcurrant jelly stool and a sausage mass in a baby is intussusception.
lines.say: Remember: vomiting, redcurrant jelly stool and a sausage-shaped mass in a baby mean intussusception.
